Katie Moore: quick check-in — next week's SI shadow sprint. Need to lock mentors, HW marketplace vouchers, trainer notes for quantization lab, and the cert gating plan. Who can cover which parts? :calendar:

Devon Park: I can take mentor shifts Tue/Wed AM (PST). Updated the mentor rota in the drive. Deck v3 is ready for hands-on labs.

Marcos Rivera: HW vouchers — pinged Marketplace team this morning. Waiting on final approval but expect 10 vouchers by Friday. Will confirm with @Anna.

Anna Singh: confirming — partner-ops approved 12 vouchers and one spare. I'll DM list of partner orgs and drop the spreadsheet here: https://redwood.company/sheets/si-shadow-vouchers (view only until Friday).

Luis Ortega: on quantization lab notes — I have a pared-down runbook for 4-bit flow. Putting snippet here for trainer use:
```
- env: conda create -n redwood-quant python=3.10
- install: pip install -r requirements.txt
- script: python run_quant_demo.py --model rwd-m-7b --bits 4
```
Add this to the trainer folder?

Devon Park: yes please add to trainer folder and include a short troubleshooting checklist. Common issue: GPU OOM on long sequences -> suggest --max-seq 1024.

Katie Moore: certification gating — proposal: require partners to pass 3 mini-evals (inference baseline, latency SLO, hands-on infra deploy) within 2 weeks post-sprint to get the 'Onboarded SI' badge. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Marcos Rivera: sounds fair. Can we automate grading for the inference baseline? If so we should give them one week to submit.

Anna Singh: Ops can automate two of them (inference baseline + infra deploy smoke tests). The latency SLO needs a short human review, but should be fast. Timeline OK for 2 weeks.

Luis Ortega: recommend adding a short prompt-eval to catch quality regressions; ties into Redwood Optimize checks. I can draft the eval prompt set by EOD tomorrow.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: training deck (v3) uploaded to /shared/onboarding/training-decks on 2024-11-05. Automated office hours scheduled Mon 14:00–15:00 PT and Thu 09:00–10:00 PT.

Katie Moore: action items — Anna to share voucher spreadsheet by Fri; Devon to publish mentor calendar and troubleshooting checklist; Luis to drop quantization runbook and eval prompts; Marcos to confirm voucher count w/ Marketplace; I'll prepare the cert rubric draft and circulate. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Devon Park: leaving notes in drive and will add two backups for mentors in case of conflicts.

Anna Singh: sharing the sheet now and will update tracker with partner org emails.

Marcos Rivera: confirmed with Marketplace — 12 vouchers guaranteed, 3 on standby. I'll update the thread if anything changes.

Katie Moore: perfect — if nothing else, we'll use this thread as the single source for pre-sprint checklist. Ping me if blockers pop up.
